messages:
Lina: kicking off dev/stg bring-up for rhea-8b (int8). want a quick sanity probe + perf snapshot before we add to onboarding board. tagging @sophie @raj

Raj: got it. quick plan: run 3 sanity prompts (qa, instruction, long-context), compare top-1 diffs vs fp16 on 50 samples, measure p50/p95 latency on devstg, and check for truncation/hallucination cases. keep it light. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: starting runs on devstg node gpu-12 now. will post raw outputs for any weird cases.

Sophie: quick prompts i'm using:
```
1) Q: "What's the capital of France?"
2) Instruction: "Summarize the paragraph below in 2 sentences."
3) Long context: (1k chars random text) + "List all dates mentioned."
```

Sophie: run1 results:
- #1 -> "Paris" ✅
- #2 -> concise summary but mentions an incorrect author (Morris) — likely hallucination ⚠️
- #3 -> model truncated midway, missed one date (possible token cap or kv-eviction) ⚠️

Tomas: what's the exact quant recipe and runtime config? batch size / kv-cache / seq_max?

Sophie: int8 per-channel (llmpack qk=8), batch=1 for these probes, kv-cache enabled, seq_max=1024. loaded with quantized weights, no load errors.

Raj: can you dump the model logits diff for the hallucinated case vs fp16? small set is fine (top5 tokens per step). that'll tell us if distribution shifted or if decoding issue.

ci-bot: perf snapshot (devstg/gpu-12) — p50=42ms, p95=118ms, tokens/sec=178, model load ok, no OOMs. CI checks: basic smoke ok.

Lina: thanks. Sophie, please paste the hallucination example into #onboard-cases and tag product-safety. we should also add a canary rollback plan (fallback to rhea-8b-fp16) if regression persists.

Sophie: pasted the snippet in #onboard-cases with logs and the fp16 comparison. sample excerpt:
```
Prompt: "Summarize..."
FP16: "...by Dr. Morris (editor)"
INT8: "...by Morris as author"  <-- false attribution introduced
```

Tomas: i'll run batch=8 latency and check kv eviction patterns under seq_max=2048. wondering if int8 kernel changes token emission timing.

Raj: action items:
- Sophie: expand to 50-sample eval, capture EM/ROUGE delta vs fp16 and top-1 token diffs
- Tomas: memory profile + batch=8 latency + kv eviction reproducibility
- Lina: add canary rollout + fallback config to the onboarding board, include safety tag

Lina: pinging @product-safety to review the pasted case. Sophie, once you have the 50-sample metrics drop them here. thanks all. :eyes:

Sophie: starting the 50-sample run, ETA ~30m. will include per-sample diffs and the handful of flagged hallucinations.

Tomas: quick note — expected int8 memory saving ~40% vs fp16 on device, so dedicated capacity cost should drop but we'll verify perf/correctness tradeoff.

Lina: great. keep updates in this thread so we have a single source for the devstg bring-up. closing loop after the 50-sample baseline and a short canary config.
